_about: Corrections to the gate map in gate-map.mjs: add or remove modules a gate covers, and files in tools/gate that are diagnostics, not gates.
_notGates: Diagnostics, the two-browser gates (gatesolo, gatelookhand: run them by name on their own; gatesolo turns solo mode on), and gatevoices (Voices is shelved and its engine is not on the lanes; run it by name).
_timeouts: Minutes a gate may take when it needs more than run-gate's default (15), as {"gatename": 30}.
